title: private/access-message.json: the invite template
description: Written by the desktop app's main process when the owner edits the invite in Settings → Sharing (SHR-09, D-143). Missing, the app's default template is used.

template.description: Up to 20 lines. Placeholders: {name}, {title}, {link}, {passcode}, {expires}, {site}; any other {word} is refused, and it needs {link} or {passcode}. A line whose placeholder has no value for an audience is left out.
